As a site member, I want to create a semi-structured personal description on my profile page, so that others can easily learn about me.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. The profile page includes fields for name, interests, and a brief bio.
2. Users can edit their descriptions at any time.
3. The description is displayed clearly to other members.

As a site member, I want to complete an application for the Certified Scrum Practitioner designation, so I can earn this certification.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. The application form is accessible to all site members.
2. The form includes all necessary fields for certification.
3. Submission confirmation is provided upon completion.
4. Users can track the status of their application.

As a Practitioner, I want to add more details to my profile page to effectively showcase my experience.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. The profile page includes fields for professional experience, education, and certifications.
2. Users can edit and save their profile details.
3. Changes are reflected immediately on the profile page after saving.

As a site member, I want to submit an application to become a Certified Scrum Trainer, so that I can teach CSM and CSPO courses and certify others.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. The application form is accessible to all site members.
2. The form includes fields for personal information, qualifications, and teaching experience.
3. Upon submission, the applicant receives a confirmation email.
4. The application status can be tracked by the applicant.

As a Trainer, I want to enhance my profile page with additional personal details, so that potential clients can better understand my background and expertise.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. The profile page should allow the addition of a biography section.
2. Users can upload a profile picture.
3. The profile should include a list of certifications and qualifications.
4. There should be an option to display testimonials from previous clients.
